question: Which prestigious Indian sports award is specifically given to outstanding coaches in sports and games? 🏆
options: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 🥇
explanation: Brilliant! Named after the legendary guru from the Mahabharata, the Dronacharya Award honors exceptional coaches who successfully train sportspersons to excel. 🏅
hint: Think of the famous 'Guru' of the Pandavas in the Mahabharata.

question: What does the acronym 'WHO' stand for in the context of international health? 🌍
explanation: Excellent! WHO stands for the World Health Organization, a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health. 🕊️
hint: It focuses on global 'Health'.

question: On which day is 'World Health Day' celebrated globally to mark the foundation of WHO? 🗓️
explanation: Awesome! World Health Day is celebrated every year on April 7th to commemorate the founding of the World Health Organization in 1948. 🏥
hint: It falls in the fourth month of the year.

question: Where are the headquarters of the World Health Organization (WHO) located? 🏢
explanation: Spot on! The headquarters of the WHO are located in Geneva, Switzerland, where global health policies are discussed and formed. 🌍
hint: It is in a famous Swiss city.

question: What is the primary function of the Sports Authority of India (SAI)? 🏟️
options: To train and promote sports talent in India 🏃
To sell tickets for Olympic games 🎫
answer: To train and promote sports talent in India 🏃
explanation: Great job! The Sports Authority of India (SAI) was created to promote sports, identify talent at a young age, and provide excellent training facilities. 🏅
hint: It acts as the apex national sports body for 'training' and 'promoting'.

question: In which year was the Sports Authority of India (SAI) established? 📅
explanation: Perfect! SAI was set up in 1984 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to carry forward the legacy of the 1982 Asian Games held in New Delhi. 🏆
hint: It was established two years after the 1982 Asian Games.

question: What is the highest sporting honor of the Republic of India? 🥇
explanation: Fantastic! The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is the highest sporting honor in India, awarded for spectacular and most outstanding performance in sports. 🇮🇳
hint: It is named after a legendary Indian hockey player and means 'Sports Jewel'.

question: Who was the first recipient of the Khel Ratna Award? ♟️
explanation: Brilliant! Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the first sportsperson to receive this prestigious award in the year 1991-92. 🧠
hint: He is an Indian chess grandmaster and former World Chess Champion.

question: The Arjuna Award is given to sportspersons for what achievement? 🎯
options: Consistent outstanding performance for four years 🏃
answer: Consistent outstanding performance for four years 🏃
explanation: Excellent! The Arjuna Award honors athletes who have shown consistent outstanding performance at the international level over a period of four years. 🏅
hint: It is awarded to athletes for performing very well continuously.

question: What does the winner of the Arjuna Award receive along with a cash prize? 🥉
explanation: Awesome! Winners receive a cash prize, a certificate, and a beautiful bronze statuette of the mythological hero Arjuna aiming his bow. 🎯
hint: The award is named after a great archer from the Mahabharata.

question: When is 'National Sports Day' celebrated in India? 🇮🇳
explanation: Spot on! National Sports Day is celebrated on August 29 every year to mark the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand. 🏅
hint: It is in the month of August.

question: Which award is given specifically to honor 'Lifetime Achievement' in sports and games in India? 🎗️
options: Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement 🌟
answer: Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement 🌟
explanation: Great job! This award is given to honor sportspersons who have contributed to sports through their performance and continue to promote sports after retirement. 🏑
hint: The name of the award contains the words 'Lifetime Achievement'.

question: Which trophy is awarded annually to the overall top-performing University in inter-university sports tournaments? 🎓
explanation: Perfect! The MAKA Trophy is the highest sports award for universities in India, encouraging sports at the university level. 🏫
hint: It is known by the acronym MAKA.

question: What is the full form of 'IOC' in the context of international sports? 🌐
explanation: Fantastic! The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is the supreme authority of the worldwide Olympic movement. 🏟️
hint: It is the global body that organizes the Olympic Games.

question: Where is the headquarters of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) located? 🏛️
explanation: Brilliant! The IOC headquarters is situated in Lausanne, Switzerland, often referred to as the Olympic Capital of the world. 🌍
hint: It is in a city in Switzerland, but not Geneva.

question: What is the primary role of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA)? 🇮🇳
options: To select athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games 🏅
answer: To select athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games 🏅
explanation: Excellent! The IOA is responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international athletic meets. 🏃
hint: They manage the Indian contingent for the biggest global multi-sport event.

question: Which Indian government ministry is directly responsible for sports promotion and youth development? 🏛️
options: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare ⚕️
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports 🏋️
answer: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports 🏋️
explanation: Awesome! The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS) administers sports development programs and oversees bodies like SAI. 🇮🇳
hint: The name contains the words 'Youth' and 'Sports'.

question: Which national program was launched to revive sports culture in India at the grassroots level? 🌱
explanation: Spot on! The 'Khelo India' (Play India) program was introduced to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports. 🏅
hint: The name translates to 'Play India' in Hindi.

question: What does the 'A' in the Ministry of AYUSH stand for? 🌿
explanation: Great job! The 'A' stands for Ayurveda. AYUSH stands for Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy. 🧘
hint: It is an ancient Indian system of natural and holistic medicine.

question: Which organization in India is dedicated to the promotion of Yoga and Naturopathy under the Ministry of AYUSH? 🧘‍♂️
options: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) 🌸
Board of Control for Cricket in India 🏏
answer: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) 🌸
explanation: Perfect! MDNIY is a premier institute for Yoga planning, training, promotion, and research, functioning under the Ministry of AYUSH. 🧘‍♀️
hint: It is named after a former Prime Minister of India.

question: When is the 'International Day of Yoga' celebrated worldwide? 🌍
explanation: Fantastic! The United Nations declared June 21 as the International Day of Yoga, the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere. 🧘
hint: It is celebrated on the summer solstice.

question: Who officially presents the National Sports Awards to the athletes in India? 🏅
explanation: Brilliant! The National Sports Awards are traditionally presented by the President of India at the Rashtrapati Bhavan on National Sports Day. 🇮🇳
hint: The highest constitutional authority of the country.

question: What does 'WADA' stand for in the context of international sports? 🚫
explanation: Excellent! WADA is an international independent agency whose key activities include scientific research, education, and monitoring of the World Anti-Doping Code. 🛡️
hint: It prevents athletes from using illegal performance-enhancing drugs.

question: Which organization is responsible for anti-doping regulations specifically within India? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! The National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) is responsible for promoting, coordinating, and monitoring the doping control program in sports in India. 💊
hint: It stands for National Anti-Doping Agency.

question: Which of these awards recognizes corporate entities and boards for their role in sports promotion? 🏢
explanation: Spot on! The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar is given to corporate entities, NGOs, and sports control boards for their contribution to sports promotion and development. 🤝
hint: The name translates to 'National Sports Promotion Award'.

question: Which agency is primarily concerned with the health and rights of children worldwide? 👶
explanation: Great job! UNICEF (United Nations Children's Fund) provides humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide, focusing on their health, nutrition, and education. 🌍
hint: It has 'Children's Fund' in its expanded name.

question: The 'Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award' is given to honor achievements in which field? 🧗
options: Adventure activities like mountaineering and skydiving 🏔️
answer: Adventure activities like mountaineering and skydiving 🏔️
explanation: Perfect! Named after one of the first two individuals to reach the summit of Mount Everest, this award recognizes outstanding achievements in the field of adventure. 🏕️
hint: Tenzing Norgay was a famous mountaineer.

question: Which organization in India helps people during disasters and manages blood banks? 🩸
options: Board of Control for Cricket in India 🏏
explanation: Fantastic! The Indian Red Cross Society is a voluntary humanitarian organization that provides relief in times of disasters/emergencies and promotes health and care. ❤️
hint: Its logo is a red cross on a white background.

question: What is the full form of 'SGFI' which organizes sports at the school level in India? 🏫
options: Sports and Gymnastics Federation of India 🤸
explanation: Brilliant! The School Games Federation of India (SGFI) is responsible for organizing national-level sports competitions for school children across India. 🏅
hint: It focuses on 'School Games'.

question: Which movement was launched by the Prime Minister of India to encourage people to include physical activity and sports in their everyday lives? 🚶
explanation: Excellent! The Fit India Movement was launched to bring about behavioral changes and move towards a more physically active lifestyle. 🏋️
hint: The name contains the word 'Fit'.

question: What is the 'Y' in the Ministry of AYUSH? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! The 'Y' stands for Yoga (& Naturopathy), emphasizing traditional physical and mental disciplines. 🌿
hint: It is an ancient Indian practice involving physical postures and breath control.

question: Which organization is responsible for sending Indian athletes with physical disabilities to the Paralympic Games? ♿
explanation: Spot on! The Paralympic Committee of India is the authorized body to select and send Indian athletes with physical disabilities to the Paralympic Games. 🏃‍♂️
hint: The name contains the word 'Paralympic'.

question: What does 'Special Olympics Bharat' primarily focus on? 🧩
explanation: Great job! Special Olympics Bharat is a movement that uses sports to empower people with intellectual disabilities. 🌟
hint: It focuses on athletes with 'intellectual' challenges.

question: The Dronacharya Award has two categories. One is the 'Regular' category. What is the other? ⏳
explanation: Perfect! The Dronacharya Award is given in two categories: Regular (for recent achievements) and Lifetime (for producing outstanding sportspersons over a period of 20 years or more). 🎗️
hint: It honors a coach's entire career.

question: What does 'NSNIS', a premier sports institute under SAI located in Patiala, stand for? 🏫
options: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports 🏅
National Sports Network of Indian Schools 🎒
New System of National Indian Sports 🏏
National Society for Nurturing Indian Sports 🤝
answer: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports 🏅
explanation: Fantastic! NSNIS Patiala is Asia's largest sports institute and serves as the academic wing of the Sports Authority of India. 🏟️
hint: It is named after the famous freedom fighter 'Netaji'.

question: What is the motto of the National Cadet Corps (NCC) which promotes discipline and fitness among youth? 🎖️
explanation: Brilliant! 'Unity and Discipline' (Ekta aur Anushasan) is the motto of the NCC, aiming to develop character, comradeship, and ideals of selfless service. 🇮🇳
hint: It focuses on togetherness and following rules.

question: What is the motto of the National Service Scheme (NSS)? 🤲
explanation: Excellent! The NSS motto 'Not Me But You' reflects the essence of democratic living and upholds the need for selfless service to society. 🌍
hint: It means putting others before yourself.

question: Which Indian city hosts the Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNCPE), a major branch of SAI? 🌴
explanation: Awesome! LNCPE is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, and it is a premier institute providing excellent physical education and sports training. 🎓
hint: It is the capital city of Kerala.

question: Which of these is NOT a function of the World Health Organization (WHO)? 🚫
options: Providing leadership on global health matters 🗣️
explanation: Spot on! Organizing the Olympic Games is the responsibility of the International Olympic Committee (IOC), not the WHO. 🏟️
hint: WHO deals with health, not international multi-sport events.

question: Which sports award was previously known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award? 🥇
options: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 🌟
answer: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 🌟
explanation: Great job! In 2021, the award was renamed to Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna to honor one of India's greatest hockey players. 🏑
hint: It was renamed after a hockey legend.

question: What does the 'S' in the Ministry of AYUSH stand for? 🌿
explanation: Perfect! 'Siddha' is a traditional system of healing that originated in South India, forming an important part of the AYUSH ministry. 🧘
hint: It is a traditional medicine system from South India.

question: What does the 'U' in the Ministry of AYUSH stand for? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! 'Unani' refers to the Perso-Arabic traditional medicine system practiced in India, recognized under the Ministry of AYUSH. 🥣
hint: It is a traditional medicine system of Perso-Arabic origin.

question: Who determines the rules and regulations of a specific sport at the national level in India? 📜
explanation: Brilliant! National Sports Federations are the governing bodies for their respective sports in India, responsible for promotion and organizing national championships. 🏅
hint: They are the 'Federations' specific to each sport.

question: In which city were the first Asian Games held in 1951? 🏟️
explanation: Excellent! The inaugural Asian Games were hosted in New Delhi, India, in 1951, marking a major milestone in Indian sports history. 🏅
hint: It is the capital city of India.

question: Which of the following awards is NOT presented on National Sports Day? ❌
explanation: Awesome! The Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian award, not specifically a sports award, and is not given exclusively on National Sports Day. 🇮🇳
hint: It is the highest civilian award in India.

question: Which organization creates awareness about health issues like Polio, Malaria, and HIV/AIDS globally? 🌍
explanation: Spot on! The World Health Organization leads global efforts to combat diseases and promotes health awareness worldwide. 🏥
hint: It is the global 'Health' authority.

question: What is the primary role of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) during the Commonwealth Games? 🏅
options: To select and lead the Indian contingent 🇮🇳
To provide medical treatment to all athletes 🏥
To decide the rules of cricket 🏏
answer: To select and lead the Indian contingent 🇮🇳
explanation: Great job! The IOA acts as the Commonwealth Games Association in India, selecting athletes and managing the Indian team during the games. 🏃‍♂️
hint: They act as the national representative body for multi-sport events.

question: How often is the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award given? 🗓️
explanation: Perfect! The National Sports Awards, including the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna, are conferred annually by the President of India. 🇮🇳
hint: It happens once every single year.

question: Which body is responsible for implementing the 'Fit India Movement' across schools? 🏫
options: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports alongside Education Boards 🏃
answer: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports alongside Education Boards 🏃
explanation: Fantastic! The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports coordinates with schools, colleges, and local bodies to make 'Fit India' a mass movement. 🏅
hint: It requires cooperation between sports and education authorities.

question: What is the primary focus of the 'Target Olympic Podium Scheme' (TOPS) launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports? 🎯
options: To build podiums in all schools 🏫
To provide assistance to India's top athletes for Olympic medals 🏅
answer: To provide assistance to India's top athletes for Olympic medals 🏅
explanation: Brilliant! TOPS is a flagship program designed to provide customized training and financial support to potential Olympic medal winners. 🇮🇳
hint: The name implies helping athletes reach the 'Podium' at the Olympics.
